description: Verbatim upstream fixtures plus catalog snapshots. Wind source is a loop registering three scenarios. Analytics adapters are not PHP engine replays.

scenarios.excerpt:
gaScenario('spirit-of-fire-on-enter-draw')
    ->deckTemplate('lorraine-windslice', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->endTurn()
    ->tested('Spirit of Fire')
    ->expectProperty('myField-0', 'CardID', 'LMyKyVC2O9', 'Spirit of Fire is the starting champion')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 7, 1, 'On Enter drew seven cards during pregame setup')
    ->register();

1 Backup Charger
1 Purifying Thurible
# Main
4 Dungeon Guide
4 Fairy Whispers
4 Fluffy Shopkeep
4 Windslice
DECK
    )
    ->endTurn()
    ->tested('Spirit of Water')
    ->expectProperty('myField-0', 'CardID', 'tafqldAGRF', 'Spirit of Water is the starting champion')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 7, 1, 'On Enter drew seven cards during pregame setup')
    ->register();

gaScenario('aithne-spirit-of-fire-enter-draws-seven-cards')
    ->standardDeck('Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myField', 'Aithne, Spirit of Fire')
    ->observe()
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 14, 1, 'On Enter: drew seven cards on top of the opening seven')
    ->tested('Aithne, Spirit of Fire')
    ->covers(['on-enter', 'draw', 'champion'], '**On Enter:** Draw seven cards.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('exalted-card-is-not-playable-without-an-advanced-element')
    ->deck(<<<'DECK'
# Material
1 Spirit of Fire
# Main
10 Dungeon Guide
10 Fluffy Shopkeep

DECK
    )
    ->seed('myHand', 'Royal Oathguard')
    ->play('Royal Oathguard')
    ->tested('Pride of Demiourgos')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 8, 1, 'Royal Oathguard (Exalted) is refused: the champion has no advanced element')
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 1, 1, 'Nothing entered the field')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->register();

gaScenario('rai-archmage-inherited-first-mage-action-enlighten')
    ->deckTemplate('rai-windslice', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->champion(cardName: 'Rai, Archmage')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Idle Thoughts')
    ->play('Idle Thoughts')->pay(1)->answer(1, 'Top=n8wyfG9hbY,px60u5n1do,n8wyfG9hbY,n8wyfG9hbY;Bottom=')
    ->tested('Rai, Archmage')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'Counters', '{"enlighten":1}')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'TurnEffects', '["vz4kc558yx-ACTION_ACTIVATED"]')
    ->expectProperty('p1Graveyard-0', 'CardID', 'rWhFC8XBaH')
    ->expectProperty('p1GlobalEffects-0', 'CardID', 'RAI_ARCHMAGE_TRIGGERED')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 6, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('myGraveyard', 1, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 1, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('myDeck', 5, 1, 'Glimpse 4 only looks and reorders -- answering the rearrange with exactly the offered cards leaves the 5-card deck intact')
    ->register();

gaScenario('rai-spellcrafter-on-enter-enlighten')
    ->deck(<<<'DECK'
# Material
1 Spirit of Fire
1 Rai, Spellcrafter
1 Clarent, Sword of Peace
1 Backup Charger
1 Purifying Thurible
# Main
4 Dungeon Guide
4 Fairy Whispers
4 Fluffy Shopkeep
4 Windslice
DECK
    )
    ->seed('myMemory', 'Fairy Whispers')
    ->endTurn()
    ->endTurn(2)->target('myMaterial-0')
    ->tested('Rai, Spellcrafter')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'CardID', 'gPKTJKqvOI')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'Counters', '{"enlighten":2}', 'On Enter: two enlighten counters were put on Rai')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'TurnEffects', '["ENTERED_THIS_TURN"]')
    ->expectProperty('p1Banish-0', 'CardID', 'n8wyfG9hbY')
    ->expectProperty('p1Banish-0', 'Counters', '[]')
    ->expectProperty('p1Banish-0', 'TurnEffects', '[]')
    ->expectProperty('p1Material-0', 'CardID', 'm31WVJ9F04')
    ->expectProperty('p1Material-1', 'CardID', '9gv4vm4kj3')
    ->expectProperty('p1Material-2', 'CardID', 'LeyUk5auEP')
    ->expectProperty('p1GlobalEffects-0', 'CardID', 'LEVELED_UP_THIS_TURN')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 8, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 0, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('theirHand', 8, 1)
    ->register();

gaScenario('rai-storm-seer-level-per-arcane-mage-spell-banished')
    ->deck(<<<'DECK'
# Material
1 Spirit of Fire
1 Rai, Storm Seer
1 Clarent, Sword of Peace
1 Backup Charger
1 Purifying Thurible
# Main
4 Dungeon Guide
4 Fairy Whispers
4 Fluffy Shopkeep
4 Windslice
DECK
    )
    ->champion(cardName: 'Rai, Storm Seer')
    ->seed('myBanish', 'Shock Therapy')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Scry the Skies')
    ->play('Scry the Skies')->pay(1)->answer(1, 'Top=em6eEh9q8y,n8wyfG9hbY,em6eEh9q8y,px60u5n1do;Bottom=')
    ->tested('Rai, Storm Seer')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'TurnEffects', '["vz4kc558yx-ACTION_ACTIVATED"]')
    ->expectProperty('p1Graveyard-0', 'CardID', 'F9POfB5Nah')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 6, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('myGraveyard', 1, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 2, 1)
    ->expectZoneCount('myDeck', 4, 1, 'Scry the Skies\' Glimpse 4 only looks and reorders, then draws one card into memory -- answering the rearrange with exactly the offered cards leaves 5 - 1 = 4 cards in the deck')
    ->register();

gaScenario('tonoris-genesis-aegis-recollection-obelisk')
    ->deckTemplate('lorraine-windslice', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->champion(cardName: 'Tonoris, Genesis Aegis')
    ->endTurn()
    ->endTurn(2)->pass(1)->target('myTempZone-0')
    ->tested('Tonoris, Genesis Aegis')
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 2, 1, 'choosing an Obelisk summons it onto the field')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-1', 'CardID', 'wk0pw0y6is', 'At beginning of recollection phase, choosing Obelisk of Armaments summons it')
    ->register();

gaScenario('diao-chan-enchantress-enter-glimmer')
    ->deck(<<<'DECK'
# Material
1 Spirit of Water
1 Diao Chan, Enchantress
# Main
10 Dungeon Guide
10 Fluffy Shopkeep
DECK
    )
    ->seed('myMemory', 'Fairy Whispers')
    ->endTurn()
    ->endTurn(2)->target('myMaterial-0')
    ->tested('Diao Chan, Enchantress')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'CardID', '00xbh8oc00', 'The level-up into Diao Chan, Enchantress completed', step: 3)
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'Counters', '{"glimmer":2}', "Diao Chan, Enchantress's On Enter (enterAbilities[\"00xbh8oc00:0\"]) put exactly two glimmer counters on herself when she levelled up into the champion slot", step: 3)
    ->register();

gaScenario('flourishing-restoration-diao-chan-bonus-waives-the-element-for-two-more')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->champion(cardName: 'Diao Chan, Enchantress', damage: 10)
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide', player: 2)
    ->seed('myHand', 'Flourishing Restoration')
    ->play('Flourishing Restoration')->pay(4)
    ->expectDamage('p1Field-0', 4, 'Recover 3 and 3 more for the one opposing ally: 10 down to 4')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->tested('Flourishing Restoration')
    ->covers(['diao-chan-bonus', 'element-waiver', 'cost-increase'], GA_RESTORATION_WAIVER_TEXT)
    ->register();

cards.effect:
**Diao Chan Lineage**

**Inherited Effect** — At the beginning of your end phase, if the amount of **glimmer** counters on CARDNAME is less than the amount of phantasias you control, put an amount of **glimmer** counters on CARDNAME equal to the difference.

cards.effect:
**On Enter**: Put two **glimmer** counters on CARDNAME.

**Inherited Effect** — [REST]: Activate a Reaction Spell card from your memory. Pay its reserve cost only by removing that many **glimmer** counters from CARDNAME. Activate this ability only during an opponent's turn.
